Apple Orchard India
A free apple orchard guide for growers in Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Uttarakhand and new low-chill areas, built from Dr. YSP UHF Nauni, SKUAST-Kashmir, ICAR-CITH, NHB and government sources. Run by Gujarat Bio Organics Pvt. Ltd., working with farmers since 2006.
